Source: This study assessed households’ resilience to climate change-induced shocks in Dinki watershed, northcentral highlands of Ethiopia.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kuno kwekaliriza engeri amaka gye gavvuunukamu ebyekango ebiva ku nkyukakyuka mu mbeera y’obudde mu nsozi za Dinki watershed, ezisangibwa mu bukiikakkono bw’amasekkati ga Ethiopia.
Yoruba: Ìwádìí yìí ṣe àyẹ̀wo ìfẹsẹ̀múlẹ̀ ilé sí ìpagìri ìyídà ojú ọjọ́ ní Dinki watershed, àríwá-àárín ilẹ̀gíga ní ìlú Ethiopia.
Zulu: Lolu cwaningo luhlole amandla okuvuka uzibuthe kwemindeni ekuthuthumeleni okubangelwa ukuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu endaweni yase-Dinki, ezindaweni eziphakeme ezisenyakatho emaphakathi neTopiya.
Hausa: Wannan binciken ya yi la’akari da juriya ga gigicewar sauyin yanayi na gidaje ga mummunan firgicin sauyin yanayi a cikin magudanar ruwa ta Dinki, tsaunukan arewa-ta-tsakiya na Habasha.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tše di lekotše go ngangabala ga malapa go masetlapelo ao a hlolwago ke phetogo ya klaemete go šomišwa Indekse ya Go ngangabala go Klaemete go phatolameetse ya Dinki, dinagathota tša bogare bja leboa bja Ethiopia.
Amharic: ይህ ጥናት በኢትዮጵያ በሰሜን ማእከላዊ ደጋማ በዲንኪ ተፋሰስ አካባቢዎች ያሉ ቤተሰቦች በአየር ንብረት ለውጥ ምክንያት ለሚከሰቱ ነውጦች ያላቸውን የመቋቋም አቅም አስሷል፡፡

Source: The data were collected through a cross-sectional survey conducted on 288 households, three focus group discussions, and 15 key informant interviews.
Luganda: Ebiwe byakuŋŋaanyizibwa okuyita mu kunoonyereza okw’ekiseera ekimpi okwakolebwa ku maka 288, okukubaganya ebirowoozo okw’omu bibinja, awamu n’okubuuzibwa okw’abeetabi 15 ab’enkizo.
Yoruba: Dátà náà jẹ́ èyí tí a rí gbà látara ìwádìí àṣekiri tí a ṣe lórí ilé 288, ọ̀wọ́ ìjírórò mẹ́ta, àti ìfọ̀rọ̀wánilẹ́nuwò àwọn ẹni amọ̀nípaìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ 15.
Zulu: Ingcobelelo yaqoqwa ngocwaningo olwehlukanisa izigaba olwenziwa emakhaya angama-288, izingxoxo ezintathu zamaqembu okugxilwe kuwo, kanye nenhlolokhono yezimpimpi eziyi-15 ezibalulekile.
Hausa: An tattara bayanan ta hanyar wani bincike ta amsa tambayoyi da yawa da aka gudanar a kan gidaje 288, tattaunawar rukunin mayar da hankali guda uku, da kuma manyan tambayoyi 15 na tattaunawa da ɗan rahoto.
Northern Sotho: Datha e kgobokeditšwe ka tsela ya diphatišišo tše di dirwago ka nako e tee go bakgathatema ba bantši go malapa a 288, go bea leihlo ditherišano tša dihlopha tše tharo, le swara dipoledišano le bakgathatema ba 15 ba bohlokwa.
Amharic: መረጃው የተሰበሰበው በ288 ቤተሰቦች፣ በሶስት የትኩረት ቡድን ውይይቶች እና በ15 ቁልፍ መረጃ ሰጪ ቃለ መጠይቆች ላይ በተካሄደ ሰፊ የክፍል በክፍል የዳሰሳ ጥናት ነው፡፡

Source: The Climate Resilience Index (CRI) based on the three resilience capacities (absorptive, adaptive and transformative) frame was used to measure households’ resilience to climate change-induced shocks on an agro-ecological unit of analysis.
Luganda: Olutiba lw’okumanyiira ebintu ebireetebwa embeera y’obudde (CRI) okusinziira ku busobozi bw’okuvvuunuka bwa mirundi esatu (obukendeezi, obukyusi, obukyusamuyungo) lwakozesebwa okupima engeri amaka gye gavvuunukamu ebyekango ebiva ku nkyukakyuka mu mbeera y’obudde mu nneekaliriza ey’okutunuulira enkolagana wakati w’ebiramu n’obulimi.
Yoruba: Climate Resilience Index náà (CRI) tí nó dálé ìfẹsẹ̀múlẹ̀ mẹ́ta náà (agbohunsára, ìṣẹ̀dà, àti àyípadà) jẹ́ lílò láti ṣe òṣùwọn ìfẹsẹ̀múlẹ̀ ilé sí ìpagìri ìyídà ojú ọjọ́ lórí àlàyẹ́ ajẹmọ́ ìbáṣepọ̀ ọ̀gbìn àti àyíká.
Zulu: Inkomba Yamandla Okuvuka Uzibuthe Ngokwesimo Sezulu (CRI) esekelwe kwifreyimu yamandle okuvuka uzibuthe amathathu (amandla okululama, amandla okuhambisana nesimo, kanye namandla okuguqula isimo) frame yasetshenziswa ukukala ukuqina kwemizi ekuthuthumeleni okubangelwa ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu kuyunithi yokuhlaziya yezolimo nemvelo.
Hausa: An yi amfani da Fihirisar Juriyar Yanayi (CRI) dangane da ƙarfin juriya guda uku (mai shanyewaa, mai sajewa da kuma mai canzawa) don auna juriyar gidaje ga mummunan firgicin sauyin yanayi ya haifar a kan ɓangaren bincike na noman gargajiya.
Northern Sotho: Go šomišitšwe Indekse ya Go ngangabala go Klaemete (CRI) ye e theilwego go foreime ya mabokgoni a mararo a go ngangabala (a nwelelo, a kamogelego le a phetogo) go ela go ngangabala ga malapa go masetlapelo ao a hlolwago ke phetogo go yuniti ya tshekatsheko ya ekholotši ya temo.
Amharic: የአየር ንብረት የመቋቋም አቅም ጠቋሚ (አ.ን.መ.አ.ጠ)፣ ሶስት የመቋቋም አቅም ችሎታዎች (የመሳብ፣የመላመድ እና የመለወጥ) ክፍለ እይታን በመጠቀም፣ቤተሰቦችን በአየር ንብረት ለውጥ ምክንያት ለሚከሰቱ ነውጦች ያለቸውን  የመቋቋም አቅም በአግሮ ስነ-ምህዳር የትንተና ክፍል  ለክቷል፡፡

Source: A principal component analysis (PCA) and multiple regression analysis were used to identify determinant factors and indicators to households’ resilience, respectively.
Luganda: Enkola y’okufunza obubaka obungi ne bufuuka butono (PCA) awamu n’enkola y’ebibalo ey’okwekaliriza enkolagana wakati w’ekivaamu n’ebintu ebikireeta zaakozesebwa okuzuula ebiviirako n’obubonero obwoleka okuvvuunuka kw’amaka.
Yoruba: Ète principal component (PCA) àti multiple regression jẹ́ lílò láti ṣe ìdámọ̀ àwọn ìṣokùfà àti ohun ìtọ́kasí fún ìfẹsẹ̀múlẹ̀ ilé, lọ́lọ́kan-ò-jọ̀kan.
Zulu: Ukuhlaziywa kwengxenye eyinhloko (i-PCA) nokuhlaziya kwemathiphulikhesheni kwasetshenziselwa ukukhomba izici ezinqumayo kanye nezinkomba zamandla okuvuka uzibuthe kwemindeni, ngokulandelana.
Hausa: An yi amfani da nazarin muhimmin ɓangare (PCA) da kuma nazarin koma baya da yawa don gano abubuwa masu tabbatarwa da kuma masu nuni ga juriyar gidaje, bi da bi.
Northern Sotho: Go šomišitšwe tshekatsheko ya karolo ya motheo (PCA) le tshekatsheko ya poelomorago ya kgafetšakgafetša go lemoga dintlha tše bohlokwa le ditaetši tša go ngangabala ga malapa, ka bobedi.
Amharic: ለቤተሰብ የመቋቋም አቅም ወሳኝ ምክንያቶችን እና አመላካቾችን በቅደም ተከተል ለመለየት፣ የዋና አካል ትንተና (ዋ.አ.ት) እና መልቲፕል ሪግሬሽን ጥቅም ላይ ውለዋል፡፡

Source: Findings indicate that the indexed scores of major components clearly differentiated the study communities in terms of their agro-ecological zones.
Luganda: Ebyazuulibwa biraga nti obubonero bw’ebintu ebikulu bwayawula bulungi ebitundu ebyekalirizibwa okusinziira ku bitundu ebifaananya embeera y’obudde.
Yoruba: Ìwádìi fi hàn pé èsi ìṣájú ti ẹ̀ka pàtàkì ṣe ìyàtọ̀ tó jọjú láàárín ìwádìí àwọn ọ̀wọ́ kọ̀ọ̀kan ní ìbámu pẹ̀lú agbègbe ọ̀gbìn àti àyíká wọn.
Zulu: Okutholakele kukhombisa ukuthi amaphuzu anenkomba ezingxenye ezinqala ahlukanise ngokusobala imiphakathi yocwaningo ngokuya ngezindawo zayo zezolimomvelo.
Hausa: Bincike ya nuna cewa awun manyan abubuwan da aka lissafa sun bambanta a sarari a tsakanin al’ummomin binciken dangane da yankunan noman gargajiya ɗinsu.
Northern Sotho: Dikutollo di laetša gore dintlha tše šupilwego boteng tša dikarolo tše bohlokwa di tloga di farologantšhitše ditšhaba tše di nyakišišwago go ya ka ditikologo tša ekholotši tša tšona tša temo.
Amharic: ግኝቶቹ የዋና አካላት የመረጃ ጠቋሚ ውጤቶች የጥናቱን ማህበረሰቦች ከግብርና ስነ-ምህዳር ዞኖቻቸው አንጻር በግልጽ እንደሚለዩ ይጠቁማሉ፡፡

Source: Specifically, the absorptive capacity (0.495) was the leading contributing factor to resilience followed by adaptive (0.449) and transformative (0.387) capacities.
Luganda: Okusingira ddala, obusobozi bw’okukendeeza (0.495) ye yali ensonga enkulu ereeterawo okuvvuunuka n’eddirirwa obukyusi (0.449) n’obukyusamuyungo (0.387).
Yoruba: Ní pàtó, ipá agbohunsára náà (0.495) jẹ́ ìdí tó léwájú sí ìfẹsẹ̀múlẹ̀ tí ipá ìṣẹ̀dà (0.449) àti àyípadà (0.387) tẹ̀lé.
Zulu: Ngokuqondile, amandla okululama esimweni (0.495) abeyisici esibambele phambili e zamandleni okuvuka uzibuthe okulandelwa amandla okuguqula isimo (0.449) kanye noguquko (0.387).
Hausa: Musamman, iyawar mai shanyema (0.495) shi ne babban abin bayar da gudummawa ga juriya wanda mai sajewa ya biyo baya (0.449) da kuma ikon mai canzawa (0.387).
Northern Sotho: Gabotsebotse, bokgoni bja nwelelo (0.495) e bile ntlha ye bohlokwa ye e bakago go ngangabala ya latelwa ke mabokgoni a kamogelego (0.449) le a phetogego (0.387).
Amharic: በተለይም የመሳብ አቅም በ(0.495) ለመቋቋም አቅም  ቀዳሚው ምክንያት ሲሆን፣ በመቀጠል የመላመድ (0.449) እና የመለወጥ (0.387) ችሎታዎች ይካተታሉ፡፡

Source: Likewise, the Midland was relatively more resilient with a mean index value of 0.461.
Luganda: Mu ngeri y’emu, ekitundu ky’omu masekkati kyalina obusobozi bw’okuvuunuka bwa wagguluko n’omuwendo omukkati gwa 0.461.
Yoruba: Bákan náà, Àwọn àárín ìlú ni wọ́n ní ìfẹsẹ̀múlẹ̀ jùlọ pẹ̀lú àbọ àpapọ̀ ọ̀ǹkà 0.461.
Zulu: Ngokunjalo, i-Maphakathi nezwe ibinamandla okuqina uma kuqhathaniswa nenani lenkomba elilindelekile elingu-0.461.
Hausa: Haka nan, Tsakiyar ƙasa ta kasance mafi juriya tare da ƙimar matsakaicin fihirsa 0.461.
Northern Sotho: Go no swana, Midland e be e ngangabetše kudu ka boleng bja tšhupaboteng ya magareng ya 0.461.
Amharic: በተመሳሳይ ሚድላንድ በ0.461 አማካይ የጠቋሚ ዋጋ የበለጠ ተቋቋሚ ነበር፡፡

Source: Both the PCA and multiple regression analysis indicated that access to and use of livelihood resources, such as farmlands and livestock holdings, diversity of income sources, infrastructure and social capital were determinants of households’ resilience.
Luganda: PCA awamu n’enkola y’ebibalo ey’okwekaliriza enkolagana wakati w’ekivaamu n’ebintu ebikireeta byalaga nti obusobozi bw’okufuna awamu n’okukozesa ebintu abantu bye beetaaga okwebeezaawo gamba ng’ettaka eririmirwako, ebizimbe awamu n’enkolagana abantu gye balina mu kitundu byali biviirako obusobozi bw’amaka okuvvuunuka.
Yoruba: PCA àti ète multiple regression fihàn pé ìfàyègbà àti ìlo ohun ìgbáyégbádùn, bí i oko àti ohun ọ̀sìn, ọ̀pọ orísun dúkìá, ìdàgbàsókè àti ìgbafẹ́ jẹ́ ìṣokùfà ìfẹsẹ̀múlẹ̀ ilé.
Zulu: Zombili i-PCA kanye nemathiphulikhesheni zibonise ukuthi ukufinyeleleka nokusetshenziswa kwezinsiza zokuziphilisa, njengezindawo zamapulazi nezigcinamfuyo, ukuhlukahluka kwemithombo yemali engenayo, ingqalasizinda kanye nempilonhle yomphakathi kwakuyizinqumi zamandla okuvuka uzithathe kwemizi.
Hausa: Dukkansu ƙididdigar PCA da kuma koma baya da yawa sun nuna cewa samun dama da amfani da albarkatun rayuwa, kamar filayen noma da kadarorin kiwo, bambancin hanyoyin samun kuɗin shiga, abubuwan more rayuwa da taimakekeniya su ne abubuwan da suke tabbatar da juriyar gidaje.
Northern Sotho: Bobedi PCA le tshekatsheko ya poelomorago ya makga a mantši di laeditše gore phihlelelo go le tšhomišo ya methopo ya bophelo, ye bjalo ka dipolase le dikampa tša leruo, go fapafapana ga methopo ya letseno, mananeokgoparara le dipeeletšo tša leago e bile dintlha tšeo di hlohleletšago go ngangabala ga malapa.
Amharic: ሁለቱም የዋ.አ.ት እና መልቲፕል ሪግሬሽን ትንተናዎች የእርሻ መሬቶች እና የእንስሳ እርባታ ይዞታዎች የመሰሉ የገቢ ምንጮች እና እንደ መሰረተ ልማት እና ማህበራዊ ካፒታል ያሉ የመተዳደሪያ ሃብቶችን ማግኘት እና መጠቀም ለቤተሰብ የመቋቋም አቅም ወሳኝ ምክንያቶች መሆናቸውን ያመለክታሉ፡፡

Source: In general, it might be due to their exposure to recurrent shocks coupled with limited adaptive capacities including underdeveloped public services, poor livelihood diversification practices, among others, the study communities showed minimal resilience capacity with a mean score of 0.44.
Luganda: Okutwaliza awamu, kiyinza okuba nga kyava ku kufuna byekango ebiddiŋŋana ng’ate obusobozi bw’okukyuka bwa wansi omuli n’empeereza embi ey’ebintu abantu bye beetaaga, okubeera mu mbeera embi, awamu n’ensonga endala, okubeera ng’ebitundu ebyekalirizibwa byayoleka obusobozi bw’okuvvuunuka bwa wansi n’omukkati gwa 0.44.
Yoruba: Ninú gbogbo rẹ̀, ó lè jẹ́ nípasẹ̀ àìláàbò sí ìpáyà àtìgbàdégbà pẹ̀lú ìwọ̀m̀ba ipá ìṣẹ̀dà ní ó níṣe pẹ̀lú iṣẹ́ ìlú tí kò dàgbàsókè, ìṣe ìgbáyégbádùn tí kò dára, àti ohun mìíràn, ọ̀wọ́ ìwádìí náà fi ìfẹsẹ̀múlẹ̀ díẹ̀ hàn pẹ̀lú àbọ èsi 0.44.
